m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Yo, now that you have PIP Recovery, you're officially a master of the Serpentine Science. And you're ready to take on Kobra Kai.
Now, the first thing you need to know about Kobra Kai is that they're a bunch of cheaters. Envious cheaters.
The Kobra Kai sensei, Qhreese, was a soldier under my command in the Serpentine Army. But I had him dishonorably discharged for insubordination.
He'll do anything to hurt me. Anything. So be careful, you know? OK. It's time. Let's go knock Kobra Kai out!
Yo, I'm tired of Kobra Kai bullying the students of my Gym. Hopefully you'll be our knockout punch!
